```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library("patchwork")
library(gtsummary)
```

### Data Collection

```{r}
# Pull data from github
link <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arinbasu/data309/refs/heads/main/diabetes_prediction_data.csv"

data = read.csv(link)
```

```{r}
# Show 20 rows of the data
head(data, 20)
```

- Age is numerical.

- Blood Glucose Level is numerical.

### Data Cleaning

```{r}
# Check for any missing data
anyNA(data$age)
anyNA(data$blood_glucose_level)
```

## Plotting

```{r}
# Plotting Histogram of age with Freedman-Diaconis Rule
binwidth_age <- 2 * IQR(data$age) / length(data$age)^(1/3)
age_hist1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth_age, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Age Histogram",
       x = "Age", y = "Count")

# Plotting Histogram of age with Freedman-Diaconis Rule doubled
age_hist2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth_age * 2, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Age Histogram",
       x = "Age", y = "Count")

age_hist1 + age_hist2
```


```{r}
# Plotting Histogram of blood glucose level with Freedman-Diaconis Rule
binwidth_bgl <- 2 * IQR(data$blood_glucose_level) / length(data$blood_glucose_level)^(1/3)
bgl_hist1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = blood_glucose_level)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth_bgl, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Blood Glucose Level Histogram",
       x = "Blood Glucose Level", y = "Count")

# Plotting Histogram of blood glucose level with Freedman-Diaconis Rule doubled
bgl_hist2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = blood_glucose_level)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth_bgl * 2, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Blood Glucose Level Histogram",
       x = "Blood Glucose Level", y = "Count")

bgl_hist1 + bgl_hist2
```

### Summarizing the data

```{r}
# Summary for the whole data
tbl_summary(data)
# Summary for age
# tbl_summary(
#   data = data,
#   include = age,
#   type = list(age = "continuous2"),
#   statistic = list(age ~ c("{mean} ({sd})",   # mean (SD)
#                                   "Median: {median}",  # median
#                                   "IQR: {p25} - {p75}")))
summary(data$age)
summary(data$blood_glucose_level)
```

```{r}
# Statistical summary of age
stat_age <- data %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age   = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_age = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age     = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Statistical summary of blood glucose level
stat_bgl <- data %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bgl   = mean(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bgl = median(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bgl     = sd(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

stat_age
stat_bgl
```
```{r}
data1 <- data %>%
  mutate(
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    `heart_disease` = factor(heart_disease, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")))

head(data1, 20)

```

### Group by Diagnosis

```{r}
# Group age by diagnosis and summarize
age_by_diagnosis <- data1 %>%
  group_by(diabetes) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_age   = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_age = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age     = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    )
age_by_diagnosis

# Group blood glucose level by diagnosis and summarize
bgl_by_diagnosis <- data1 %>%
  group_by(diabetes) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bgl   = mean(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bgl = median(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bgl     = sd(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
bgl_by_diagnosis
  
```

### Group by Diagnosis and Gender

```{r}
# Drop "Other" gender as it contributes < 0.1%
# Group age by diagnosis and gender
age_by_gender <- data1 %>%
  filter(gender != "Other") %>%
  group_by(gender, diabetes) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_age   = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_age = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age     = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unite("group", gender, diabetes, sep = "_")
age_by_gender

# Group blood glucose level by diagnosis and gender
bgl_by_gender <- data1 %>%
  filter(gender != "Other") %>%
  group_by(gender, diabetes) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bgl   = mean(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bgl = median(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bgl     = sd(blood_glucose_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unite("group", gender, diabetes, sep = "_")
bgl_by_gender

```

```{r}
plot_bgl_diagnosis<- bind_rows(
  bgl_by_diagnosis %>% 
    mutate(Statistic = "Mean",   Value = mean_bgl)  %>%
    select(diabetes, Statistic, Value),
  bgl_by_diagnosis %>% 
    mutate(Statistic = "Median", Value = median_bgl)  %>%
    select(diabetes, Statistic, Value),
  bgl_by_diagnosis %>%
    mutate(Statistic = "SD", Value = sd_bgl)  %>%
    select(diabetes, Statistic, Value)
)

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
ggplot(plot_bgl_diagnosis, aes(x = diabetes, y = Value, fill = Statistic)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, position = pd) +
  labs(title = "Mean, Median, and SD by Diagnosis", x = "Diagnosis", y = "Blood Glucose Level", fill = "")
  
```

```{r}
plot_age_diagnosis <- age_by_diagnosis %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean_age, median_age, sd_age), names_to = "Statistic", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Statistic = recode(Statistic,
                       mean_age = "Mean Age",
                       median_age = "Median Age",
                       sd_age = "SD Age"))

ggplot(plot_age_diagnosis, aes(x = diabetes, y = Value, fill = Statistic)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  labs(title = "Mean, Median, and SD by Response", x = "Diagnosis", y = "Age", fill = "")
  
```
